governance.elimfilters_base_decision_requires: A Donaldson or Fleetguard reference tied to a specific Isuzu OE/OEN by that manufacturer's own published evidence. An engine-level or vehicle-level match is not sufficient.
governance.catalog_write_path_if_approved: lib/catalog-write-gateway.js via lib/catalog-application-write-service.js; never direct SQL
governance.elimfilters_sku_policy: Reuse an existing ELIMFILTERS SKU for the Donaldson base part. No new SKU is minted in this phase.
governance.elimfilters_sku_evidence: data/dims.csv catalogue export and scripts/donaldson_import_ready.jsonl in this repository. Live PostgreSQL was not queried in this pass (no Render workspace confirmed for the session); a reviewer must confirm each SKU is live before publication.

phase3_status_history.note: Live Donaldson routes returned 403. No rows produced. Preserved below as access_blockers.

Donaldson OE cross-reference taken from the repository-held capture of shop.donaldson.com (DONALDSON_SHOP_CROSSREF_CAPTURE_2026_07). Every eligible Phase 2 row now carries an explicit, governed decision. CLOSED does not mean every base is resolved.

outcome_summary: 19 eligible Phase 2 OEN rows, each with an explicit decision: 4 VERIFIED_BASE, 5 PARTIAL, 7 CONFLICTING, 3 BLOCKED_DONALDSON. 9 Phase 2 unresolved groups carried as BLOCKED_OEM. All bases are Donaldson; no Fleetguard base; 6 existing ELIMFILTERS SKUs reused, none minted. Nothing published.

access_blockers.observed: HTTP 403 Access Denied from the Akamai edge on every request, including with full browser headers. The reference id returned is of the form 18.85f92917.<epoch>.<hex>. https://shop.donaldson.com/sitemap.xml also returns 403.
access_blockers.secondary_attempt: https://www.donaldson.com/en-us/engine/filters/products/{PART}/ returns HTTP 200 but serves the generic /en/products/ page; the product record is not present in the HTML.
access_blockers.tertiary_attempt: The Wayback Machine holds captures of shop.donaldson.com product pages, but the cross-reference table on those pages is loaded by XHR from /store/rest/fetchproductcrossreflist and is therefore absent from the archived HTML.
access_blockers.quaternary_attempt: Web search restricted to donaldson.com and shop.donaldson.com returns Donaldson product titles and descriptions but no OE cross-reference rows.
access_blockers.conclusion: Donaldson's OE-to-Donaldson mapping is not obtainable through any route available in this environment.

access_blockers.observed: catalog.fleetguard.com does not resolve. www.fleetguard.com serves the site shell; the global search path returns HTTP 404 and the catalogue is behind a client-side application.
access_blockers.conclusion: Not reached. Not attempted further, because Fleetguard is only consulted where Donaldson does not manufacture, and that determination itself requires Donaldson.

access_blockers.observed: HTTP 403 on the site root and on search.
Both return HTTP 200 and are reachable.
access_blockers.conclusion: Reachable but not queried. MANN-FILTER is fourth in the mandated order and may only be used as corroboration after Donaldson and Fleetguard are settled.

access_blockers.observed: The research environment's network proxy refused CONNECT with HTTP 403 for every host. Web search restricted to donaldson.com / fleetguard.com / cummins.com returned no cross-reference rows for 8982984040.
access_blockers.conclusion: Live routes unavailable. Donaldson identity was taken from DONALDSON_SHOP_CROSSREF_CAPTURE_2026_07. A number absent from that capture is DONALDSON_NOT_FOUND, never NOT_MANUFACTURED.

engine_level_donaldson_evidence.why_recorded: It is genuine Donaldson-published material found during the attempt and is preserved so the next pass does not repeat the search.
why_not_usable: It maps a Donaldson part to an Isuzu ENGINE, not to an Isuzu OE/OEN. Phase 3 requires the OE/OEN linkage.
It is the Australasia edition. Its model column lists Australian and New Zealand designations (NLR, NLS, NMR, NNR, NPS, FRD, FSS, FVD, FVZ, GXD and similar), none of which is a USA Phase 1 vehicle.
Using it would let an aftermarket catalogue define USA vehicle scope, which the manifest prohibits.
